about: TRASH MOB SWARMS (Dom 2026-10-28 approved): packs of weak goblins roam the open world OUTSIDE the boss pads; most die in one or two hits, they drop coins and feed XP and heat (a hook: the kill event carries `xp` and `heat`, and the page calls window.__v3Heat?.(event) when a Hunter heat system installs one). Every number lives here; the code (src/zone/mobs.ts, the pure core; src/fight/mob-swing.ts reads the hero's swing off the sim; src/mobs-run.ts wires it to the page) writes none (scripts/as-data scans src/zone/ at zero). Validated by src/sim/validate-mobs.js at load and by test/mobs.test.mjs. PERFORMANCE is the whole risk, so: `cap` is the hard ceiling of mobs in the world at once (alive, dying and lying; default 12 near the hero, `capMax` is only the typed-array size and the validator's ceiling); every per-mob field is a preallocated typed array (no per-frame allocation); the AI is seek + leash + separation + an attack-token limit, no pathfinding and no duel per mob; the hero's blow is tested with the sim's own blade sweep (src/fight/blade.ts bladeImpact) against the mob's capsule only while the hero's swing is in its active frames and only for mobs within `swingMetres`, damage and knockback read off the same move rows the bosses are hit with (data/moves, RULES.location); the mob body is ONE shared asset (src/fight/scene.ts draws each slot as a pooled actor of that body, one tinted material shared by all, the weapon hidden), the scene never loads it until the first pack is live. PACKS: the open world is a grid of `cellMetres` cells; a cell holds a pack with the ring's `density` (a hash of the cell and `seed`, so it is the same pack at the same place every visit); a pack is live while the hero is within `activateMetres`, its members come in as slots free, never closer than `spawnMinMetres` to the hero (no pop-in), and drop out beyond `despawnMetres` (the pack keeps its count); a cleared pack stands again after `respawnSeconds`. A pack is never placed within `startClearMetres` of the pit centre nor within `padMetres` of any boss spot plus its leash, and every tick a mob inside a boss's circle is walked out of it; while a boss fight is on (any boss engaged, the hero down) no pack aggros and the live mobs walk home (`suppress`). The hero is never killed by a mob (`lethal` false: a mob's blow leaves him at `floorHealth` at least; the hero death flow stays the bosses'); guard blocks a mob's blow and a roll's invulnerable frames dodge it, as against a boss. API for the Pit Crawl: Mobs.spawnPack(areaId, kind, count) and Mobs.onMobKilled(cb) (src/zone/mobs.ts). RINGS: `rings` keys are data/rings.json ring ids (a distance in a gap between rings, or beyond the last, takes the nearest ring below it; ring 1's pit is sparse, ring 3 is dense); `default` is the row for a zone with no rings. THE BODY: `body` is a data/rig.json files stem. STAND-IN until OpenTrident's mh-crowd-b1-05 lands (<1.2 MB): big-vegas (0.68 MB); switch the one row, nothing else changes. `scale` shrinks it, `tint` + `tintMix` make the goblin green. Rat and undead kinds are later rows. THE ART: the goblin is a human crowd model (OpenTrident mob-crowd-b1-05) at 0.6x tinted green, a stand-in until a real goblin body exists. THE FALLEN BOSS (reviewer 2026-10-28; Dom's top bug is cutting the corpse): `corpse` = when a held boss falls its body is a corpse pad (position + `nearMetres` + `padMetres`, where no mob spawns or stands) for `holdSeconds` (the physics.json corpse.keepSeconds), and the hero near it (within `nearMetres`, which must cover physics.json cut.strike.nearM, the any-attack-press cut of PR #252) or within `graceSeconds` of the kill keeps every pack suppressed (nobody aggros, spawns or lands a blow); `max` corpses are remembered. THE FLOOR: the hero is never killed by a mob, so a hero held at `hero.floorHealth` could farm: `farm.decay` is the multiplier each further kill pays at the floor (coins, xp, heat all x decay^n, coins floored), reset when his health is above the floor again (the next boss engage rebuilds the fight at full health).
